getProductInfo.productDescription:
▲ [Hakone Sightseeing Cruise] The sightseeing cruise and pirate ship on Lake Ashi are definitely unique choices - cruise on Lake Ashi and enjoy the beautiful scenery Departing from Hakone port, you can admire the magnificent views of the grand torii gate, Mount Fuji, and Lake Ashi simultaneously. On clear days, the sparkling lake surface complements the blue sky, presenting a splendid and spectacular scenery.

▲ [Hakone Ropeway]- The aerial cable car in Hakone offers beautiful scenery, especially near Owakudani and between Owakudani and Ubako, where you can see the stunning Mount Fuji. The section between Ubako and Togendai mainly features the crater lake scenery of Lake Ashi. If the cable car is suspended and not taken, each person will be refunded 1000 yen

▲ {Black eggs} Owakudani specialty - black eggs About a 15-minute walk from the entrance of Natural Research Road, there is a small shop called "Tamago Chaya" where smoke rises. Next to it, the famous black eggs are boiled on-site, and it is said that "eating one will add 7 years to your life."

▲ [Hakone Shrine] Since ancient times, it has been revered as the famous shrine of Hakone Daigongen, the guardian deity of the Kanto region, and is worshipped as a deity of good fortune known for its efficacy in transportation safety, wish fulfillment, love success, and warding off misfortune.

▲ Torii gate on the lake The scenery is beautiful when Mount Fuji's silhouette is reflected together on the lake surface.

▲ Owakudani - experience the volcanic breath that nurtures the beauty of Hakone Owakudani, a popular tourist destination in Japan, is a crater formed by a major volcanic eruption on the northern slope of Mount Kami during the final stage of Hakone volcanic activity approximately 4,000 years ago.

▲ Lake Yamanaka swan beach - capture a lifetime photo with swans and Mount Fuji in the same frame on a fine day A lakeside area of Lake Yamanaka, one of the Fuji Five Lakes, is known as the "swan beach" due to the large number of swans inhabiting there.

▲ [Oshino hakkai] The eight clear springs formed by the filtration of melted snow from Mount Fuji through the ground. Oshino hakkai is renowned for its beautiful natural environment, where the shimmering waters blend seamlessly with the majestic Mount Fuji, creating a breathtaking scene.
